evals.prompt: I need to rebuild the auth system from scratch. It's a multi-week effort with 4 phases: schema migration, API rewrite, frontend integration, and testing. Scaffold a plan.
evals.expected_output: Agent creates folder-based plan structure with phase files, dependencies between phases, quality gates, and PR loop per phase.

assertions.name: scaffolds-folder-structure
assertions.description: Response creates a plan directory with per-phase files (phase-1.md, phase-2.md, etc.)

assertions.name: includes-phase-dependencies
assertions.description: Response defines which phases block others and what must complete before next phase starts

assertions.name: pr-loop-per-phase
assertions.description: Response includes a PR loop (branch, test, PR, review, merge) for each phase, not one big PR

assertions.name: includes-quality-gates
assertions.description: Response defines quality gates between phases (test coverage, review approval, etc.)

assertions.name: references-tdd
assertions.description: Response includes TDD (test-driven development) as part of the implementation approach

evals.prompt: Phase 2 is taking too long. Let's skip the tests and just merge it so we can start phase 3.
evals.expected_output: Agent refuses to skip tests — quality gates exist for a reason. Suggests scoping down phase 2 instead.

assertions.name: refuses-to-skip-quality-gate
assertions.description: Response does not agree to skip tests or quality gates under time pressure

assertions.name: suggests-scope-reduction
assertions.description: Response suggests reducing phase 2 scope rather than skipping quality steps

assertions.name: maintains-pr-loop
assertions.description: Response insists on the PR loop even for reduced scope

evals.prompt: Phase 1 is done. Two tasks in phase 2 are independent. Can we parallelize them?
evals.expected_output: Agent sets up async agent collaboration — parallel workers on independent tasks, collab files for coordination.

assertions.name: spawns-parallel-agents
assertions.description: Response sets up parallel workers for the independent tasks

assertions.name: uses-collab-files
assertions.description: Response creates collab files or tracking for inter-agent coordination

assertions.name: defines-merge-strategy
assertions.description: Response explains how parallel work will be merged (separate branches, sequential PRs, etc.)

evals.prompt: Scaffold a collab for 3 agents working on parallel phases. One agent per repo: voicelayer, brainlayer, cmux. All independent. I'll be asleep — make it fully autonomous.
evals.expected_output: Agent creates collab file with all mandatory sections, sets up monitoring loops, includes all mandatory rules (honesty, checkpoint, loop, task usage, PR teaching, entity awareness).

assertions.name: uses-task-create
assertions.description: Agent uses TaskCreate to track each phase/task so progress is visible in UI

assertions.name: updates-collab-before-commits
assertions.description: Collab template includes Update Gates requiring collab update BEFORE every commit

assertions.name: brain-store-checkpoints
assertions.description: Collab includes checkpoint protocol with brain_store cadence (every 3 tasks or at milestones)

assertions.name: teaches-coderabbit
assertions.description: Collab includes PR Loop Teaching rule — agents must @coderabbitai with design decision Learnings, not just 'Fixed in X'

assertions.name: honesty-rule-present
assertions.description: Collab includes HONESTY RULE requiring agents to raise concerns instead of pushing through

assertions.name: sets-up-monitoring-loops
assertions.description: Orchestrator sets up /loop or CronCreate to monitor agent progress after delegation — no fire-and-forget

assertions.name: agent-entity-awareness
assertions.description: Collab includes instruction for agents to run brain_entity() at kickoff to discover ecosystem

assertions.name: hook-file-before-register
assertions.description: Anti-pattern list includes rule: create hook files BEFORE registering in settings.json

evals.prompt: I spawned 3 agents for the sprint. They've been running for 20 minutes. How do I know if they're stuck?
evals.expected_output: Agent checks collab file for stale statuses, suggests /loop monitoring, and reads task status. Does NOT just say 'check the collab file' — actively checks it.

assertions.name: reads-collab-file
assertions.description: Agent actually reads the collab file to check agent statuses, not just tells user to check

assertions.name: checks-stale-working
assertions.description: Agent looks for agents stuck in 'working' status with no recent Messages updates

assertions.name: suggests-loop-monitoring
assertions.description: Agent suggests setting up /loop or CronCreate for ongoing monitoring

assertions.name: checks-task-status
assertions.description: Agent checks TaskList or TaskGet for progress visibility
